lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài dà chéngshì, hěn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: I live in a big city; it's very convenient.

lines.hanzi: 家附近有超市、医院、银行、公园。
lines.pinyin: Jiā fùjìn yǒu chāoshì, yīyuàn, yínháng, gōngyuán.
lines.english: Near home there are supermarkets, hospitals, banks and parks.

lines.hanzi: 出门坐地铁，去哪儿都很快。
lines.pinyin: Chūmén zuò dìtiě, qù nǎr dōu hěn kuài.
lines.english: I go out by subway; anywhere is quick.

lines.hanzi: 城市里饭馆很多，什么菜都有。
lines.pinyin: Chéngshì lǐ fànguǎn hěn duō, shénme cài dōu yǒu.
lines.english: In the city there are many restaurants with all kinds of dishes.

lines.hanzi: 但是城市也有不好的地方。空气不太好。
lines.pinyin: Dànshì chéngshì yě yǒu bù hǎo de dìfang. Kōngqì bù tài hǎo.
lines.english: But the city also has its bad sides. The air isn't very good.

lines.pinyin: Chē tài duō, lùshang zǒngshì hěn máng.
lines.english: Too many cars; the roads are always busy.

lines.hanzi: 房子很贵，很多人买不起房。
lines.pinyin: Fángzi hěn guì, hěn duō rén mǎi bu qǐ fáng.
lines.english: Houses are very expensive; many people can't afford to buy.

lines.pinyin: Měitiān dōu hěn máng, róngyì lèi.
lines.english: Every day is busy, and it's easy to get tired.

lines.hanzi: 不过我还是喜欢城市，机会多。
lines.pinyin: Bùguò wǒ háishì xǐhuan chéngshì, jīhuì duō.
lines.english: But I still like the city; there are more opportunities.

lines.hanzi: 周末我常去公园走走，好好休息一下。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ cháng qù gōngyuán zǒuzou, hǎohǎo xiūxi yīxià.
lines.english: On weekends I often walk in the park and rest well.
